tip.execModes: How callers may invoke this resource: blocking, stream, async-poll or async-callback. Press Enter to add.

tip.name: The unique model id callers request (e.g. anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet). Immutable after creation.
tip.resource: Which resource/upstream this model routes to.
tip.display: Optional human-readable label shown in lists.
tip.modality: The data type this model handles. Immutable after creation.
tip.capabilities: Features this model supports — toggle the ones that apply.
tip.visibility: Public = available to all tenants; Tenant = only granted tenants can use it.
tip.visibilityTenant: Tenant-only: grant access per tenant from the grants drawer.
tip.price: Price in µcredits per token. 1 credit = 1,000,000 µcredits.
tip.rateLimit: Max requests/min per tenant for this model (model rate limit). Stacks on top of the tenant/resource limits.
tip.fallbackModels: Model degradation chain: when a BLOCKING chat exhausts all of this model's channels (retryably), retry these models in order. Non-streaming only.
tip.status: Disabled models are hidden from callers.
tip.maker: The model's maker (anthropic/alibaba/z-ai…) — filter by developer
tip.icon: Pick a brand icon for this model; leave empty to inherit its channel/plugin icon

form.platformPlaceholder: Pick the platform this channel belongs to
form.platformAutoHint: Leave as Auto — on save a platform for this provider+modality is reused or created.

tip.platform: The platform (resource/upstream) this channel belongs to. Routing aggregates channels per platform.
tip.platformAuto: Auto by default: leave empty to reuse/create a platform for this provider+modality on save, or pick an existing one.
tip.plugin: The plugin this channel groups under (模型接入 3-pane grouping). Native vendor channels still route by provider_type — they don't run the sandbox.
tip.modality: The modality used when creating a new platform (carried from the chosen plugin).
tip.provider: Free-text upstream provider for this channel (e.g. openai, anthropic). The logo resolves from this value.
tip.providerAuto: Auto-filled from the chosen plugin (editable); the dropdown lists the provider types the backend actually supports.
tip.icon: Pick a brand icon for this channel; leave empty to derive it from the plugin/provider.
tip.endpoint: Override base URL for this channel. Leave empty to use the provider default.
tip.model: Upstream model name to call (e.g. gpt-4o). Leave empty to use the resource default.
tip.proxyRef: Optional reference to an outbound proxy configuration.
tip.weight: Routing weight — higher values receive a larger share of traffic across active channels.
tip.cost: Operator cost — what you pay upstream per 1M tokens. Used to compute margin against resale price. Leave 0 to omit.
tip.status: Disabled channels are skipped by routing.
tip.credentialRef: Id of the encrypted secret holding this channel's API key. Use "New credential" to create one.
tip.faultPolicy: Bind a fault-tolerance policy — same-channel retry + backoff + per-attempt timeouts. Leave empty for engine defaults (single attempt).
tip.proxy: Pick a managed proxy for this channel. Selecting one binds it; leave empty for a direct connection (or the global UPSTREAM_PROXY_URL).
tip.proxyRefAdvanced: Advanced: a proxy id or an env locator (SECRET_<KEY>) — usually just use the dropdown above.
tip.config: Provider-specific key/value settings for this channel (e.g. async submit/poll paths).

form.name: Name
form.noRules: No rules — a bound subject is unlimited
form.alertPctHint: Record an alert when usage reaches this % of the cap (0 = off)
form.modelScopeHint: Empty = all models; a model name = that model only

confirm.deleteMsg: Delete "{{name}}"? Bound keys / tenants revert to unlimited.

form.name: Policy name
form.retryMessagesPlaceholder: e.g. Internal server error — Enter to add

tip.mode: Retry on error: re-try the SAME channel per the settings below when a trigger matches. Fast fail: return the first error (cross-channel failover still applies).
tip.backoffMs: Delay between retries; exponential doubles it each attempt.
tip.ttft: Max wait for the first streamed token (0 = default). Critical for streaming LLMs.
tip.idle: Max idle between streamed chunks (0 = default).
tip.retryCodes: Retry only when the HTTP status matches one of these (can include normally-non-retryable codes like 404); empty → the adapter's built-in verdict.
tip.retryMessages: Retry when the error message contains any of these substrings (case-insensitive).

confirm.deleteMsg: Delete policy "{{name}}"? Bound channels fall back to engine defaults.

tip.url: Full proxy URL incl. credentials, e.g. http://user:pass@host:port, socks5://host:1080. Encrypted at rest, never shown back.
tip.urlNew: Supports http/https/socks5/socks5h. SOCKS is exercised by egress only when HTTP_EGRESS=curl.
tip.urlEdit: Re-enter only to change it; leave empty to keep the current URL.

confirm.deleteMsg: Delete proxy "{{name}}"? Bound channels fall back to a direct/global connection.

tip.method: How the price is computed: unit rate, matrix table, fixed amount, formula, or pass-through of upstream cost.
tip.timing: Pre = charge an estimate before the call; Post = charge the actual usage after the call completes.
tip.fixedCredits: The flat price in human credits (1 credit = 1,000,000 µcredits). The backend converts it to µcredits.
tip.resourceVersion: The resource version this price applies to. Defaults to the resource's current version.
tip.version: Version number for this price entry; bump it to supersede an earlier price.

tip.provider: Upstream provider this price is published by (e.g. openai, anthropic). The logo resolves from this value.
tip.modelSlug: The provider's model identifier (e.g. gpt-4o or claude-3-5-sonnet).
tip.price: Price in US dollars per 1M tokens. Stored as integer µUSD ($1 = 1,000,000 µUSD).
tip.cachedInputPrice: Optional discounted rate for cached input tokens, per 1M.
tip.effectiveAt: The date this published price takes effect.
tip.sourceUrl: Link to the provider's pricing page this figure was taken from.

tip.name: A unique name for this routing group (e.g. default, premium).
tip.ratioPercent: Group price ratio as a percent — 100 = ×1.00 (official price), 150 = ×1.50 (+50%). Stored as basis points.
tip.ratioLive: Group price ratio — 100 = ×1.00 (official price), 150 = ×1.50. This multiplies REAL customer billing for keys bound to this group. Stored as basis points.
tip.status: Disabled groups are skipped by routing.
tip.description: Optional note describing what this group is for.
